rv.q: The script may be overly ambitious, but there is still plenty here for fans of Sherlock Holmes or murder mysteries in general to enjoy.
Do not miss this delightful, stimulating play.
MISS HOLMES RETURNS is the second in what I’m hoping will be an ongoing series.
Miss Holmes Returns is a fun mystery and a fine way to spend an afternoon or evening.
Miss Holmes Returns offers a blend of fan-service Sherlockiana with a healthy dose of sisterhood.

This is the rare historical piece that feels blisteringly relevant to the modern day; rarely have I had so much fun at the theater while also feeling so refreshingly validated by a show’s politics and message.

cn.t: Critics praise this clever gender-bent Sherlock Holmes sequel for its brilliant storytelling, phenomenal technical craft, and feminist reimagining of the Victorian detective, with performances executed with "passion and panache."
